evals.name: book-price
evals.prompt: Add a clearable price input in the Books editor.
assertions: Stores number or null and passes that state as value.
Passes its setter as onChange and names the field Price.

evals.name: select-author
evals.prompt: Add a searchable author selection to the book fields. Names may repeat.
assertions: Takes options with a unique string key and visible label.
Controls the nullable key through value and onChange rather than storing a label.
Passes loading and failure to the control.

evals.name: publication-date
evals.prompt: Bind a clearable publication date to the book editor.
assertions: Uses Date or null rather than a formatted string.
Connects value and onChange to the same state and supplies an accessible name.
